title: What affects the cost of your car insurance?
description:
We're always checking our prices to make sure you get the best one possible.

Here are a few things that affect the cost of your cover:

  • Your information - generally, older drivers who have been driving for longer will pay less for their insurance than young or new drivers.
  • Where you live - we check the number of claims in your area and what they're for. For example, if you live in an area where there's a lot of car theft, your insurance could be more expensive.
  • The car you insure - all cars in the UK are put into car insurance groups, which we consider when setting our prices. Find out more about car insurance groups and how they're worked out.
  • Your driving habits - the more you drive, the more likely you'll be involved in an accident. If you spend a lot of time on the roads, your insurance could be pricier.
  • Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) - we legally have to add a 12% tax to your car insurance. Read more about IPT here.
